title: Early wages in show business
summary: A dollar and a half a night was top pay and twenty-five dollars a week made you a headliner.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: Lee, when you first started in show business, didn't you work for a dollar and a half or a couple or two dollars or something like that? What were the wages?
Well, when I started out, a dollar and a half a night was top salary. And when you got twenty-five dollars a week, well, you were a headliner.
